en: < It's all gone. They took it while you slept. >
< Years of work trapped in an unsalvageable pile of rubble. >
... This is the one.
This... My spot...
< It's been too long, Returner. I hope my smell doesn't offend; it's the burnt corpses all around us, see? The whole Villa is gone. Did you know this would happen? >
< Did you come here to comfort me? Or are you looking for something? Like all that stuff you kept stashed here? >
Anything, please... (Dig into the rubble.)
< Sorry, Returner. It's not my fault I'm dead. I see the rubble is burning your hands; I want to help... Do I have anything to salvage? >

< Oh. An old <u>military ration.</u> You brought this to me a few days ago; it smelled like dead Bandits. And something else: a small <u>wooden box</u> where you used to keep some ammo... That is the best I can do. >
How...? (Take a look around.)
< They destroyed me, Returner. Lobbed explosives to collapse me and my friends, then rushed in to execute your trapped fellows-in-scavenge. See their <u>limbs?</u> Then they set fire to us all. >
< We are no longer a place where life happens. So I've been sitting here, in a <u>pool of blood,</u> resisting the rain. What about you? Were you sleeping? Is that why you abandoned me? >
(Prepare to leave.)
(Open the wooden box.)
< Isn't this great? The box avoided the fire somehow... However, seems like the cartridges are bust. Unusable, even if you had a proper gun. >
< I will count this as a win, Returner. You still have the box. Don't you want it? You're putting my gift back. >
(Pick up the ration.)
< Ah, the package has melted at the corner... Must have been directly exposed to fire. You shouldn't try to eat this. >
< Looks like all those small, hard-won comforts you used to enjoy within me are gone, dissolved under the embers. But don't be too sad, Returner – everyone loses to Zalesye, not just you. >
(Squint at a body part.) Vultures...
< Yes. There are also foreign limbs among the destruction: two, for each two-dozen of ours. A massacre. And they'll be hunting you down, see. No one gets to survive them. >
< All those warmongers know is cruel violence, unrelated to survival. I do not blame you for hiding. >
(Check the blood under your boots.) Why...?
< Dried, red clumps corroded by acidic rain. Are we sure your own blood doesn't look like this, Returner? You have been here so long. >
< I don't know why this happened. I'm just an ex-shack with no notion of politics. Why, I don't even know what's on the North side of Lake Pavlie... Do you? >
< You know you can't stand being here anymore. >
... Nothing I can do here.
< I will still be here after you leave. So will my friends. >
... Can't be wasting time...
< Are you thinking about "rebuilding?" They will just take everything away again. >
